name: Call to Arms
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The head of the beast is ready to be taken off... with great force, adventurer. You have shown every sign that you are able to help us with this final mighty blow. The leaders of these attacks have made their lair within the ruins of Stromgarde, a glaring symbol of human frailty.

Find and slay those Boulderfist lords and their lackey shaman who would try and drive us from these lands.
narrative.objectives: Kill 7 Boulderfist Shaman and 3 Boulderfist Lords and return to Drum Fel in the Hammerfall outpost.
narrative.offerRewardText: You do your people proud, adventurer. The threat has been greatly lessened, and I am sure we will begin to thrive here in the Highlands.
narrative.requestItemsText:
I see your courage finally wanes. It seems my instincts were correct about you: your strength is nothing compared to your bravado.

Return to me when the beast's head has been severed, or return never again.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 32 to 40, 11,100 XP in all.

quests.objectiveText: Kill 8 Boulderfist Ogres and 10 Boulderfist Enforcers, then find Drum Fel in the Hammerfall outpost in Arathi Highlands.

quests.objectiveText: Slay 10 Witherbark Axe Throwers, 10 Headhunters and 8 Witch Doctors, and return to Drum Fel in the Hammerfall outpost.
